title: Give every reading one Look sheet and a seven-button bar
acceptance: The reading bar has at most seven buttons (plus Dive when the text has threads).
Live and embed origins keep the controls.js set; e2e/live-mcp.spec.js and controls.test.js stay green.
Every control is reachable by keyboard and on a phone.
LIVE-004 is witnessed on a release that includes this change (the embed plays through the same Chamber).

evidence.note: Part A: six-button bar plus Dive, one Look sheet reusing existing live handlers; embed and /live unchanged; rendered at three widths. Part B (look switching mid-reading, pace in the bar) remains. Merged.
Part B: looks row with live switches, pace control in the seventh slot; rendered at three widths.

activity.summary: Seeded from Package C3 after the owner decisions.
Started before the LIVE-004 witness on the owner's direction (2026-10-07); LIVE-004 is to be witnessed on a release that includes it.
Part B opened as #478; remaining acceptance is the LIVE-004 witness on a release that includes it.

summary: Seven-button bar plus Dive and one Look sheet for every reader-origin reading (#474, #478): looks switch in place where a live path exists; gallery looks in a reading opened without a gallery, and rhythm changes, wait on a reopen-at-position path. Remaining acceptance: LIVE-004 witnessed on a release that includes this.
